name: 04d-version-migration
description: Migrates a Java project to a new language level and/or framework version in a sandbox copy: detects the baseline and the application's migration surfaces, records the pre-migration build and behaviour, plans the impact, applies previewed deterministic OpenRewrite transformations where the reference pack offers them, iterates evidence-driven build rounds until green on the target runtime, compares behaviour, and renders docs/agent_output/04-remediation/migration_<slug>.md plus a cumulative migration_<slug>.diff.
